shortDescription: आवेदन शुरू हो चुके है | UP SCVTUP ITI Online Form 2026 – Link Active. Start Date: 11 July 2026 | Last Date: 04 August 2026. Apply at scvtup.in / admissionscvtup.in.
content:
आवेदन शुरू हो चुके है ✅ State Council for Vocational Training, UP (SCVTUP) has activated the online registration link for ITI Admission 2026–27.

Start Date: 11 July 2026
Last Date: 04 August 2026

Application fee: Gen/OBC ₹250, SC/ST ₹150 (as notified). Portals: scvtup.in / admissionscvtup.in.

Fill the form online, upload documents, pay the fee, and take a printout of the submitted application. Wait for merit list and counselling rounds as scheduled by SCVTUP.
